GameDiscovery.description: Aggregated discovery state for one game (matches TS `GameDiscovery`).

localized_name.description: Appinfo display override, including its default name fallback.

name_language.description: Present only when the override matches a known interface language.

GameMatch.description:
Wire-ready game match result (protocol v5 `GameMatch`, p1-contract §9).

P3 produces this shape; the protocol envelope only references it from P4 on,
so adding the derives here does not change the generated v4 contracts.

GameMatchStatus.description: Status of a persisted game match, derived by [`super::r#match::derive_game_status`].

GameSourceSummary.description: Output-only summary; injected with a flattened [`SourceRule`].

complete.description: Whether the current published index snapshot covers the whole source.

interval_hours.description: Configured automatic update interval in hours (`0` = off).

next_due_at.description: Next scheduled attempt derived from `checked_at + interval_hours * 3600`.

origin.description:
`"builtin"` (compiled default) or `"added"` (user rule, including one that
shadows a builtin id).

revision.description: Current published index revision (0 when no index snapshot exists).

direct.description: Direct EXE extraction: incomplete runs leave written files in place.

download_url.description: Chosen trusted download; especially important for explicit manual selection.

selection_id.description:
Dynamic selection route (`zip-selection-*`); absent for signed catalog
releases (p1-zip-orchestration §4.2).

source_id.description: Display attribution from the current trusted source candidate.

RawSourceRule.description:
Deserialization intermediate: loose field types so `validate_rule` can return
the exact Python error codes.

related_index_pages.description: Only present after sources.py merges index records.

SourceMatch.description:
Output of `matches()`: the matched source entry plus its rule/ release ids
(field names mirror the Python `{**selected, source_id, release_id,
root_layout}` dict and the TS `SourceSubscription` shape).

SourceRule.description: Validated canonical rule; field names match the Python rule dict.

SourceSummary.description: Output-only summary; injected with a flattened [`SourceRule`].

complete.description: Whether the current published index snapshot covers the whole source.

interval_hours.description: Configured automatic update interval in hours (`0` = off).

next_due_at.description: Next scheduled attempt derived from `checked_at + interval_hours * 3600`.

origin.description:
`"builtin"` (compiled default) or `"added"` (user rule, including one that
shadows a builtin id).

revision.description: Current published index revision (0 when no index snapshot exists).

oneOf.description:
Dynamic publisher ZIP candidate (P1). Never authoritative for apply; the
selection still re-resolves inside `install_patch` (p1-zip-orchestration §1).
Dynamic publisher EXE candidate (reserved P2/P3; P1 only blocks).

content_id.description:
Dynamic publisher content identity (`exe-content-*`). `None` for ZIP and
signed transactions, and for journals written before the field existed.

direct.description:
Direct EXE extraction: an unfinished journal is reported as incomplete
and never blocks a fresh install. Legacy rows omit this field.

has_replacements.description:
Whether this operation temporarily snapshots existing bytes for failure
recovery. Successful new installations do not retain those snapshots.

selection_id.description:
Dynamic publisher selection identity (`zip-selection-*` / `exe-selection-*`).
`None` for signed (`managed_zip`) transactions and for journals written
before the field existed (p1-host-contract §1.1/§6.3).

description: All output types share one schema graph; no host maintains a DTO table.
